    • _INVALID_getOnlinePlayers

      @Deprecated Player[] _INVALID_getOnlinePlayers()
      已过时。
      superseded by getOnlinePlayers() 已被 getOnlinePlayers() 取代
      Gets an array copy of all currently logged in players. 获取所有当前已登录玩家的数组副本。

      This method exists for legacy reasons to provide backwards compatibility. It will not exist at runtime and should not be used under any circumstances. 此方法因历史遗留原因而存在，用于提供向后兼容。它在运行时并不存在，任何情况下都不应使用。

      返回:
      an array of Players that are currently online 当前在线玩家的数组

    • getOnlinePlayers

      Collection<? extends Player> getOnlinePlayers()
      Gets a view of all currently logged in players. This view is a reused object, making some operations like Collection.size() zero-allocation. 获取所有当前已登录玩家的视图。该 视图 是一个被复用的对象，使得诸如 Collection.size() 之类的操作零分配。

      The collection is a view backed by the internal representation, such that, changes to the internal state of the server will be reflected immediately. However, the reuse of the returned collection (identity) is not strictly guaranteed for future or all implementations. Casting the collection, or relying on interface implementations (like Serializable or List), is deprecated. 该集合是由内部数据结构支持的视图，服务端内部状态的更改会立即反映到其中。但不严格保证未来或所有实现都会复用（同一标识的）返回集合。对该集合进行转型，或依赖其接口实现（如 Serializable 或 List）已弃用。

      Iteration behavior is undefined outside of self-contained main-thread uses. Normal and immediate iterator use without consequences that affect the collection are fully supported. The effects following (non-exhaustive) teleportation, death, and kicking are undefined. Any use of this collection from asynchronous threads is unsafe. 在自包含的主线程用途之外，迭代行为是未定义的。正常的、不会影响集合的即时迭代器使用完全受支持。在 传送、死亡 和 踢出（不限于这些）之后的影响是未定义的。从异步线程使用此集合是不安全的。

      For safe consequential iteration or mimicking the old array behavior, using Collection.toArray(Object[]) is recommended. For making snapshots, ImmutableList.copyOf(Collection) is recommended. 对于需要产生后续影响的安全迭代，或模拟旧的数组行为，建议使用 Collection.toArray(Object[])。如需制作快照，建议使用 ImmutableList.copyOf(Collection)。

      返回:
      a view of currently online players. 当前在线玩家的视图。

    • getTicksPerAnimalSpawns

      int getTicksPerAnimalSpawns()
      Gets default ticks per animal spawns value. 获取动物生成的默认刻间隔值。

      Example Usage:

      • A value of 1 will mean the server will attempt to spawn monsters every tick. 值为 1 表示服务器每刻都会尝试生成怪物（原文如此）。
      • A value of 400 will mean the server will attempt to spawn monsters every 400th tick. 值为 400 表示服务器每 400 刻才会尝试生成怪物（原文如此）。
      • A value below 0 will be reset back to Minecraft's default. 小于 0 的值将被重置回 Minecraft 默认值。

      Note: If set to 0, animal spawning will be disabled. We recommend using spawn-animals to control this instead. 注意：如果设为 0，动物生成将被禁用。我们建议改用 spawn-animals 来控制此项。

      Minecraft default: 400. Minecraft 默认值：400。

      返回:
      the default ticks per animal spawns value 动物生成的默认刻间隔值

      int getTicksPerMonsterSpawns()
      Gets the default ticks per monster spawns value. 获取怪物生成的默认刻间隔值。

      Example Usage:

      • A value of 1 will mean the server will attempt to spawn monsters every tick. 值为 1 表示服务器每刻都会尝试生成怪物。
      • A value of 400 will mean the server will attempt to spawn monsters every 400th tick. 值为 400 表示服务器每 400 刻才会尝试生成怪物。
      • A value below 0 will be reset back to Minecraft's default. 小于 0 的值将被重置回 Minecraft 默认值。

      Note: If set to 0, monsters spawning will be disabled. We recommend using spawn-monsters to control this instead. 注意：如果设为 0，怪物生成将被禁用。我们建议改用 spawn-monsters 来控制此项。

      Minecraft default: 1. Minecraft 默认值：1。

      返回:
      the default ticks per monsters spawn value 怪物生成的默认刻间隔值

    • isPrimaryThread

      boolean isPrimaryThread()
      Checks the current thread against the expected primary thread for the server. 将当前线程与服务器的预期主线程进行比对。

      Note: this method should not be used to indicate the current synchronized state of the runtime. A current thread matching the main thread indicates that it is synchronized, but a mismatch does not preclude the same assumption. 注意：此方法不应用来指示运行时当前的同步状态。当前线程与主线程一致表明其是同步的，但不一致并不能排除同样的假设。

      返回:
      true if the current thread matches the expected primary thread, false otherwise 当前线程与预期主线程一致则为 true，否则为 false

    • loadServerIcon

      CachedServerIcon loadServerIcon(File file) throws IllegalArgumentException, Exception
      Loads an image from a file, and returns a cached image for the specific server-icon. 从文件加载图片，并返回该特定服务器图标的缓存图片。

      Size and type are implementation defined. An incompatible file is guaranteed to throw an implementation-defined Exception. 尺寸与类型由实现定义。不兼容的文件保证会抛出由实现定义的 Exception。

      参数:
      file - the file to load the from 要从中加载的文件
      返回:
      a cached server-icon that can be used for a ServerListPingEvent.setServerIcon(CachedServerIcon) 可用于 ServerListPingEvent.setServerIcon(CachedServerIcon) 的缓存服务器图标
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if image is null 如果图片为 null
      Exception - if the image does not meet current server server-icon specifications 如果图片不符合当前服务器图标规范

    • getPluginsFolder

      File getPluginsFolder()
      Returns the de facto plugins directory, generally used for storing plugin jars to be loaded, as well as their data folders. 返回事实上的插件目录，通常用于存放待加载的插件 jar，以及它们的 数据文件夹。

      Plugins should use Plugin.getDataFolder() rather than traversing this directory manually when determining the location in which to store their data and configuration files.

      插件在确定存储其数据与配置文件的位置时，应使用 Plugin.getDataFolder()，而不是手动遍历此目录。

      返回:
      plugins directory 插件目录
